date-tvdb.reason: 30 AniDB episodes against 30 TVDB S1 episodes in the same order. AniDB titles are "Episode N" plus a Japanese subtitle; TVDB titles are "Episode NN" (only ep 1 has a real title: "Why!? Competition with zero practice" = AniDB 1 "Naze Da!? Renshuu Zero de Kyougikai"). The count and numbering agree, so the numbers decide. The date differences are TVDB's weekly placeholder dates: AniDB records a hiatus (ep 11 1996-09-09, ep 12 1996-10-14; ep 21 1996-12-16, ep 22 1997-01-13) that TVDB does not, which shifts eps 12-30 by 5-8 weeks. The suggested targets S1E29 and S1E30 are episodes 29 and 30, not 22 and 23.
